intro: Camping 101: Cooking is an introductory quest that instructs adventurers on the essentials of wilderness camping through the art of cooking. By learning to start a campfire from local trainers like Zarrin in Dolanaar, travelers establish the necessary anchor for setting up wilderness camps. It marks the first step toward mastering outdoor survival and outfitting personal campsites.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, adventurer. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.
Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

clips.title: Completion
paras: With this, you'll be able to set up a camp anywhere out in the wilderness. What you've learned is just the basics, so you won't be able to place too many furnishings around it.
Raise your cooking skill and you might just be able to learn to make even bigger fires.
You can also learn the basics of furnishing your campsites from other tradeskill trainers if you're savvy in their skills.
